definitions.explanation: A deduction from the usual price.

⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{割引|わりびき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: I bought it at a 20% discount.

examples.english: This store has a sale every Friday, and everything is 10% off.

notes:
{割引|わりびき} refers to a reduction in price, commonly used in shopping and business contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X%{割引|わりびき}: X% off
- X{割|わり}{引|び}き: X0% off (e.g., 2{割引|わりびき} = 20% off)
- {割引|わりびき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a discount
- {割引|わりびき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be discounted

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{割引|わりびき}: student discount
- ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧{割引|わりびき}: group discount
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}{券|けん}→割引券：09545_waribikiken⟧: discount coupon
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}→割引価格：25782_waribikikakaku⟧: discounted price

- ⟦{値引|ねび}き→値引き：05424_nebiki⟧: price reduction
